name: Busa SEO

agentPrompts.label: Summarize what needs my attention
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-seo` skill in this folder, then open the overview and summarize the search-performance KPI deltas, the biggest query and page movers, and how many items are waiting in the opportunities, GEO, and entity-readiness queues.

agentPrompts.label: Review the SEO opportunities queue
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-seo` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then walk me through the pending SEO opportunities so I can approve, edit, or block each one — do not touch live site content yourself.

agentPrompts.label: Review the GEO optimization queue
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-seo` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then walk me through the pending GEO opportunities queue, calling out anything the geo-qa gate is blocking and why, before I decide.

agentPrompts.label: Are we cited by AI answer engines?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-seo` skill in this folder, then show me which AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot) currently cite the brand for the tracked prompts, and the overall AI-visibility trend.
